api.name: describe
api.summary: List the problems (presets) with their ids, dimensions, end times and parameters, and the fields, variables and choices a setup can make.

api.name: check
api.summary: Check a setup document before running it. Returns `ok`, an `error` if it cannot be read at all (with the key at fault), `notes` (keys dropped, values held to their range), and `issues`: each with a level (`error`: a rule broken, such as a star without isolated self-gravity, or a value that cannot work; `warning`: a choice to look at again, such as a softening under two cells, bodies that overlap or leave the box, a grid past the GPU memory), a sentence, and the path of the part or option it is about. Use it after writing or changing a document and before `load`.

api.name: preset
api.summary: A preset’s whole setup document: a starting point for one of your own.

api.name: load
api.summary: Build a new run from a setup and leave it paused at t = 0. A setup is a preset with overrides, or a whole setup document (`document`) that assembles a run from parts: point masses, stars, disks, gas regions, obstacles, a magnetic field. The setup uses the keys of a shareable link, as a query string ("problem=sedov&dim=2&n=512&gamma=1.4") or an object ({"problem": "sedov", "dim": 2, "n": 512}). Returns the run’s state, including `query`, the setup in force.

args.name: setup
args.description: Query string, link, or object of setup keys; or a setup document itself

args.name: document
args.description: A setup document (format "shaderous-setup", see docs/setups.md and describe().setup): the run is built from it, and `setup` then says the grid and what differs. Start from preset(id) to make one

api.name: loadAthdf
api.summary: Start a run from an .athdf file: one Shaderous wrote continues exactly; another code’s is loaded into the current problem. Paused at the file’s time.

api.name: state
api.summary: The run: problem, dimensions, grid, amr levels, time, timestep, steps, end time, whether it has finished, the GPU adapter, and `query`, the setup that reproduces it.

api.name: run
api.summary: Advance the run: to time `until` (the last step is shortened to land on it exactly), by `steps` steps, or whichever comes first. Stops at the problem’s end time (stopped: "end"); to go further, load with a later `tend`. Returns t, dt, steps, steps taken, wall seconds and why it stopped.

until.description: Run until the clock reads this time

steps.description: Take at most this many steps

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this much wall time, in milliseconds

api.name: step
api.summary: Take n steps (one, without n).

api.name: runTo
api.summary: Run until the clock reads t, landed on exactly.

api.name: restart
api.summary: Start the run again from its initial conditions, paused.

api.name: play
api.summary: Let the page’s own loop step the run, as the Run button does.

api.name: pause
api.summary: Stop the page’s own loop from stepping the run.

api.name: diagnostics
api.summary: Totals and extremes read back now: mass, momentum, kinetic/internal/gravitational/total energy, max Mach number, floored cells, Jeans-unresolved cells, center of mass, point masses, and the [min, max] of every field.

api.name: debris
api.summary: Debris energies, for problems that track them (describe: problems[].debris, e.g. tidal-disruption): the gas binned by its specific orbital energy about the point mass, both what has left the box (tallied as it left) and what is in it, a surviving self-bound core set apart, and the return rate of the bound debris to pericenter, dM/dt (Kepler).

api.name: stats
api.summary: Least, greatest and volume-weighted mean of each variable over the box (rho, press, vel1-3, r0 and species mass fractions).

api.name: slice
api.summary: A variable on a res x res grid on a plane through the box (perpendicular to `axis` at fraction `pos`).

variable.description: One of rho, press, vel1, vel2, vel3, r0, level, or the name of a species. Default rho

api.name: probe
api.summary: The gas at points given as fractions of the box ([x, y, z], z ignored in 2D): density, pressure, velocity, passive scalar, refinement level and species mass fractions.

api.name: screenshot
api.summary: A picture of the run as a PNG image.

overlays.description: { colorbar, triad, status }: draw the color bar, the axes and the status line over the picture (all off by default)

api.name: record
api.summary: Record the run from where it is as an MP4 movie (H.264), stepping it as it goes: the current view with a color bar, x/y/z axes and the status line (grid, simulation time) over it. A frame every `every` steps, or near every `dt` of code time (at the nearest step boundary: no step is shortened, so the run is the one it would have been unrecorded). Stops at `until`, after `frames` frames, or at the end time. Set the view first.

dt.description: A frame near every multiple of this much code time (default: a 600th of the dynamical time of the problem, so one dynamical time plays in 10 s at 60 fps)

every.description: Or a frame every this many steps

until.description: Stop when the clock reaches this time (landed on exactly)

height.description: Default 1080 (9/16 of width when width is given)

bitrate.description: Bits per second of movie (default 0.2 bits per pixel per frame)

overlays.description: { colorbar, triad, status }, all on by default

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this much wall time, keeping what was recorded

download.description: Hand the file to the browser as a download (default true)

base64.description: Return the file in the result as `base64`

api.name: stopRecording
api.summary: End the recording under way: the file is finished with the frames recorded so far.

api.name: recordingStatus
api.summary: The recording under way, or null.

api.name: view
api.summary: Change what screenshots show without touching the run. Returns the view settings.

args.name: changes
args.description: Any of mode, field, species, log, lo, hi, sliceAxis, slicePos, minRho, opacity, yaw, pitch, dist, tx, ty, tz, zoom, cx, cy, showBlocks, contours, nContours, fog, surfaceOpacity, light, box, fieldLines, fieldLineCount, colormap, autoRange

api.name: athdf
api.summary: The state of the gas as an .athdf file (HDF5 in Athena++’s layout; yt reads it), base64. The file carries the setup, so loading it continues the run exactly.

api.name: controls
api.summary: The control panel as it stands: every control’s id, kind, label, tooltip, value and options. Use with `control` to change settings mid-run.

api.name: control
api.summary: Set a panel control (or press a button, with no value) exactly as a person would, mid-run, and wait for what it starts (a shader rebuild, a restart). Examples: control("riemann", "hll"), control("eos", "gas_radiation"), control("reset"). Number fields take values in the units the panel shows; set control("units", "code") first for code units. The run stays paused.

api.name: errors
api.summary: What the page has reported going wrong (uncaught errors, failed shader builds, a lost GPU device), oldest first.
